items.title: Mia Thornton and More Former 'RHOP' Stars: Where Are They Now?
items.summary:
Over the years, the Real Housewives of Potomac series has parted ways with several cast members.

Viewers said goodbye to Monique Samuels after her altercation with Candiace Dillard-Bassett during season 5 made her reconsider her time on the show. After joining the series in 2017, Monique and Candiace initially formed a close friendship. Things took a turn, however, when a miscommunication escalated into a physical fight .

Cameras were rolling as Monique grabbed Candiace by the hair during October 2020 episode and then proceeded to pull her down. Later in the episode, the businesswoman attempted to run back into the building to continue her argument with Candiace.

Monique, who shares three kids with husband Chris Samuels , was later charged with second-degree assault . The “Not for Lazy Moms” podcast host filed a counterclaim against Candiace the same month. Both assault charges were dismissed in December 2019.

Following an appearance in the season 5 reunion, Monique announced her exit from RHOP . Although Monique seemingly has no plans to return to the franchise, her former costar Katie Rost has made cameos since her respective departure. After appearing in the first season of the show, Katie’s full-time role was reduced and she didn’t appear in season 3.

The model briefly returned in season 4 in a “friend” of status but later claimed she was not invited to the reunion. More recently, she popped up for a brief appearance during season 7 in October 2022.

items.title: Kate Gosselin Slams ‘Disgusting’ Haters Over Her Dog's Amazon Wishlist
items.summary:
Kate Gosselin has a pointed message for her “haters.”

“Somebody yesterday asked me to post a list for Koda, as well, so I did,” Gosselin, 51, began a Friday, November 20, TikTok video. “I posted a short list and noticed that yesterday the entire list was purchased. I was like, ‘Oh my gosh, everyone’s so amazing.’ That’s so kind and so sweet.”

Upon further evaluation, Gosselin realized that none of the items were actually purchased.

“Most of the items were purchased by one person and it was marked ‘purchased from elsewhere,’” she claimed. “It occurred to me that, yeah, that was not purchased. It was marked as purchased so that no one else will purchase it for Koda, and I just have a message for haters.”

Kate Gosselin Confirms She Joined TikTok: ‘This Is Actually My Account’ 

Gosselin continued, “You’re disgusting. If you are that desperate to hate me through my dog, rest assured, Koda will not go without those items. I will make sure she gets them.”

The Kate Plus 8 alum recently shared a list of holiday presents for her dog, including bedding, grooming supplies and toys. After discovering the alleged hater’s actions, she edited her Amazon list and “unmarked” the gear as purchased so they could be available for those actually intending to buy the items.

“I’m not asking anyone to [buy anything], but I’m just saying make sure you buy them from Amazon, so it’s marked correctly and I know that it’s purchased,” she noted. “I’m saying I will buy them if need be, she will not go without, and if you’re that desperate to hate me through my sweet rescue dog who had a rough…

Rather, DB Ventures, the licensor of the David Beckham brand, is causing a bit of a stink about the fact that the football legend’s fragrance range was found on sale in the discount store as well as at other purveyors of budget goods. It is now suing the perfume company, Coty, which it further accuses of under reporting sales, for $41m (£31m).
